guard: an exact pull request head is green only when every workflow derived from the repository declarations exists for that PR and SHA and completed successfully
why: The guard and its smoke are repository tools rather than a published package boundary, so this
config grades them as a tool. The smoke imports scripts/pr-head-gate.mjs directly, and two cells
also execute the shipped pnpm pr-head-gate command against deterministic GitHub API responses.

mutations.name: flow event list comments hide pull_request again
mutations.expectRed: ordinary YAML comments after a flow event list preserve pull_request
mutations.cell: ordinary YAML comments after a flow event list preserve pull_request

mutations.name: invalid workflow YAML silently contributes no expected workflow
mutations.find: if (problem) throw new Error(`${file}: invalid YAML: ${problem.message}`);
mutations.expectRed: invalid workflow YAML fails closed instead of shrinking the expected set
mutations.cell: invalid workflow YAML fails closed instead of shrinking the expected set

mutations.name: empty on sequence silently contributes no expected workflow
mutations.find: if (on.length === 0) throw new Error(`${file}: top-level on sequence must not be empty`);
mutations.replace: if (false) throw new Error(`${file}: top-level on sequence must not be empty`);
mutations.expectRed: an empty on sequence fails closed
mutations.cell: an empty on sequence fails closed

mutations.name: empty on mapping silently contributes no expected workflow
mutations.find: if (events.length === 0) throw new Error(`${file}: top-level on mapping must not be empty`);
mutations.replace: if (false) throw new Error(`${file}: top-level on mapping must not be empty`);
mutations.expectRed: an empty on mapping fails closed
mutations.cell: an empty on mapping fails closed

mutations.name: unsupported pull_request filter is silently ignored
mutations.find: if (unsupported.length) throw new Error(`${file}: unsupported pull_request filter: ${unsupported.join(", ")}`);
mutations.replace: if (false) throw new Error(`${file}: unsupported pull_request filter: ${unsupported.join(", ")}`);
mutations.expectRed: a pull_request filter the guard cannot evaluate fails closed
mutations.cell: a pull_request filter the guard cannot evaluate fails closed

mutations.name: missing expected workflow stops failing closed
mutations.expectRed: a missing expected workflow keeps the exact head red
mutations.cell: a missing expected workflow keeps the exact head red

mutations.name: runs from another pull request satisfy the named workflow
mutations.expectRed: a successful run attached to another pull request does not satisfy this pull request
mutations.cell: a successful run attached to another pull request does not satisfy this pull request

mutations.name: a run for another commit satisfies the exact head
mutations.expectRed: a successful run for another commit does not satisfy the exact head
mutations.cell: a successful run for another commit does not satisfy the exact head

mutations.name: queued and running expected workflows count as green
mutations.expectRed: PR #1087 head 87e61678 positive mint control: minted but unfinished workflows are pending
mutations.cell: minted but unfinished workflows are pending

mutations.name: failed expected workflows count as green
mutations.expectRed: a completed non-success workflow is reported as failing, not missing or pending
mutations.cell: completed non-success workflow is reported as failing

mutations.name: unsupported workflow path glob is silently literalized
mutations.find: if (/[\\[\]{}()+|]/.test(pattern)) throw new Error(`unsupported workflow path pattern: ${pattern}`);
mutations.replace: if (false) throw new Error(`unsupported workflow path pattern: ${pattern}`);
mutations.expectRed: unsupported GitHub glob syntax fails closed instead of being treated as a literal
mutations.cell: unsupported GitHub glob syntax fails closed

mutations.name: shipped command omits a missing YAML-derived workflow
mutations.expectRed: the shipped pr-head-gate command reports the YAML-derived Hidden workflow green
mutations.cell: the shipped pr-head-gate command reports the YAML-derived Hidden workflow green
